The shell paints ~/work/mac and mbp. Quit holla❯?, postgresql@17, and ~/work/box stay absent. Paste Homebrew services and Enter. The page paints redis started and does not paint postgresql@17. Paste Open btm and Enter. The monitor paints q quits the monitor. Ctrl+Q opens the quit guard. src/bin/holla/app.rs open_quit_confirm uses the local title Quit holla❯? when world.host.remote is false, and the body says still running. Confirming Leave paints leaving when the cleanup settles · its report and log land first from on_layer_result while the process is still running, and the dialog is gone. A second Ctrl+Q paints Already stopping · the shell leaves when every process is gone from request_quit while the process is still running, then the shell exits 0. A separate launch opens Open btm and Ctrl+Q. The body contains still running. Quitting stops what holla started and the button is Stop and quit. Confirming paints stopping and quitting when every process is gone while the process is still running, then the shell exits 0.
